$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for IDE autocomplete. The value is informational only — the loader does not fetch or validate against it. Add this to enable IDE schema activation and field-level autocomplete in editors that support JSON Schema (VSCode, Zed, IntelliJ).

agents.description: Per-agent configuration overlays keyed by bundled agent name. Unknown keys are rejected with a Zod parse error listing every valid bundled-agent name. To overlay a user-defined agent, configure it through OpenCode-native config (.opencode/opencode.json) instead.

model.description: Model identifier in provider/model format, or null to inherit parent model

color.description: Agent color — named token from OpenCode or 6-digit hex color (#RRGGBB)

categories.description: Per-category configuration overlays keyed by category name

model.description: Model identifier in provider/model format, or null to inherit parent model

color.description: Agent color — named token from OpenCode or 6-digit hex color (#RRGGBB)

additionalProperties.description: Per-category configuration overlay (same fields as agent minus disable)

disabled_skills.description: Array of bundled skill names to disable globally. Unknown skill names are rejected at parse time.

disabled_agents.description: Array of bundled agent names to disable globally. Unknown agent names are rejected at parse time.

disabled_commands.description: Array of command names to disable globally

enabled.description: Enable bootstrap prompt injection into every conversation

file.description: Path to a custom bootstrap prompt file
